desc: Ideation complete: select sweep-right-cut with lazy segment tree as primary approach.
Read N and A, compute prefix distinct counts L[i] and suffix distinct counts R[i].
Implement an efficient lazy segment tree over possible left cuts supporting range add and range max query.
Sweep right cut j from 2 to N-1, update segment tree using previous occurrence of A[j], query best left cut i<j, and combine with R[j+1] to update answer.
Test edge cases (N=3, all equal, all distinct, repeats near ends) and sample tests; if too slow, switch to iterative lazy segment tree or sqrt decomposition.
